content:
New Apple TV tvOS apps aren't released every day. Shopify has just launched Shopcast, helping merchants bring their business overview to the big screen.

The new listing states: "Shopcast turns your Apple TV into a dashboard for your Shopify business." It helps you keep track of sales, discover your best-selling products, and understand where your orders are coming from, all displayed on a screen designed for offices, retail spaces, or team meeting rooms.

Let's take a look at Shopcast's screenshots:

Here's a detailed introduction to the Shopcast TV app:

Stay on top of your business at a glance. Easily browse sales, orders, shipment volumes, and average order value. Explore order distribution through an interactive globe. Identify your star products and best-selling colours. Compare the performance of your online store and Shopify POS. Discover your busiest retail locations and customer markets. Switch between multiple connected stores and view each store's data separately. Choose between light or dark mode to match your space.

Shopify further introduces this new business dashboard app:

Designed for Apple TV. Use the Apple TV remote to browse revenue, overview, products, retail, and geographic distribution pages. Dashboard data updates periodically, making it convenient for your team to stay on top of business performance throughout the day. Connect your stores. Authorize access through Shopify to connect your online stores. The data displayed depends on your account permissions. Shopcast is only responsible for displaying an overview of your store's activity; to manage products, orders, and settings, please continue using Shopify. A Shopify store, authorization, and an internet connection are required before use. Currently only available in English.

You can download Shopcast from the App Store on your Apple TV. For merchants, this app is definitely a new way to make good use of Apple TV 4K.
